metadata.title: Qualification of Biomarker Total Kidney Volume in Studies for Treatment of Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease Draft Guidance for Industry
metadata.topic: Guidance · FDA human drugs and biologics
metadata.legal_basis: FDA Guidance Document (21 CFR 10.115). Guidance states FDA's current thinking and is not binding unless a statute or regulation requires it; the official text governs.

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.

candidates.statement: 1. Quantitative Imaging Biomarker TKV should be calculated from the left and right kidneys measured with a validated and standardized image acquisition and analysis protocol within the trial. (Please see supporting documentation for details at Biomarker Qualification Program: Qualified Biomarkers and Supporting Information .)
candidates.context: B. Conditions for Qualified Use 2. TKV-Based Patient Selection in Clinical Trials a. PATIENT POPULATION Patients with ADPKD should be at least 12 years of age b. PATIENT SELECTION Baseline TKV can be used in combination with the patient’s age and baseline eGFR as an enrichment factor in ADPKD clinical trials to select ADPKD patients at high risk for a progressive decline in renal function.
